title: kith-jmap: register/register_peer don't validate method name against METHOD_ROLES
description: Calling register('Foo/bar', handler) for a method not in METHOD_ROLES silently registers an unreachable handler — dispatch_one returns unknownMethod before reaching the handler map. Calling register_peer('Chat/get', handler) for an owner-role method causes Chat/get to silently return unknownMethod for owners (wrong map). The existing debug_assert only catches both-maps registration; it misses the wrong-map case. Add a debug_assert in register() that the method is in METHOD_ROLES with Role::Owner, and in register_peer() with Role::Peer.
